title: Jesus: Historical Figure and Mythic Archetype
description: History, language, and myth—five scholarly depths on a world-changing figure.

questions.question: What execution method do virtually all historians agree was used on Jesus?
questions.explanation: Crucifixion under Roman authority is among the most secure historical facts.

questions.question: Historians agree on crucifixion—but the name Yeshua literally means what in Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Yeshua shares roots with Joshua (Yehoshua)—'YHWH saves.'

questions.question: Yeshua, 'God saves,' was born under a star that one theory, going back to Kepler, ties to a conjunction of which two planets?
questions.explanation: A triple conjunction in Pisces in 7 BCE is one candidate; others include a comet, a nova, or a purely literary star.

questions.question: That Jupiter and Saturn sign is said to have drawn the Magi from the East—what were magi most likely by profession?
questions.explanation: Matthew says only "magi from the east." Magi were Persian or Babylonian scholar-priests who read celestial signs for kings.

questions.question: Matthew tells the priest-astronomers' story in a gospel—a genre the Greek calls 'euangelion,' meaning what?
questions.explanation: Euangelion was used for imperial victory announcements before Christians adopted it; "gospel" comes from the Old English "good spell."
